record.paper_title: Some open problems in dynamical systems
record.original_question: Let U = ⋃_{α∈DC} U_α, where for each Diophantine α ∈ T^n the set U_α consists of smooth zero-average functions ϕ on T^n for which the exact symplectic diffeomorphism F_ϕ(θ,r) = (θ + r, r + ∂ϕ/∂θ(θ + r)) preserves a smooth invariant torus on which the dynamics is smoothly conjugate to translation by α. What is the smallest real number k > 0 for which the union U is open near 0 in the C^k topology?

evidence.quote: 2.2 - Let ⋃ α∈DCUα = U ; what is the minimal number k∈R∗ + for which U is open near 0, in the Ck-topology ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 1$ and let $\mathbb{T}^n=\mathbb{R}^n/\mathbb{Z}^n$. A vector $\alpha\in\mathbb{T}^n$ is called Diophantine if there exist constants $\gamma>0$ and $\tau>0$ such that
$$|k\cdot\alpha-m|\ge \gamma|k|^{-\tau}\qquad\text{for all }k\in\mathbb{Z}^n\setminus\{0\},\;m\in\mathbb{Z}.$$
Let $\mathrm{DC}\subset\mathbb{T}^n$ denote the set of Diophantine vectors.

For a smooth function $\varphi:\mathbb{T}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ with zero mean (i.e.\ $\int_{\mathbb{T}^n}\varphi=0$), define the exact symplectic map
$$F_\varphi:\mathbb{T}^n\times\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{T}^n\times\mathbb{R}^n,\qquad F_\varphi(\theta,r)=\bigl(\theta+r,\;r+\partial_\theta\varphi(\theta+r)\bigr).$$

For $\alpha\in\mathrm{DC}$, let $U_\alpha$ be the set of smooth zero-mean $\varphi$ for which $F_\varphi$ admits a smooth invariant torus on which the restricted dynamics is smoothly conjugate to the translation $\theta\mapsto\theta+\alpha$. Set $U=\bigcup_{\alpha\in\mathrm{DC}}U_\alpha$.

Determine the smallest real number $k>0$ such that $U$ is a neighborhood of $0$ in the $C^k$ topology on smooth zero-mean functions on $\mathbb{T}^n$.
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not return a definitive resolution of the precise threshold $k$ for which the union of KAM sets $U=\bigcup_{\alpha\in\mathrm{DC}}U_\alpha$ becomes a $C^k$-neighborhood of $0$. The KAM literature (Pöschel, Salamon, Chierchia, Féjoz) discusses regularity requirements (Moser's $C^\ell$ theorems with $\ell$ depending on $n,\tau$) and Herman's optimal-regularity results, but no source found explicitly identifies the minimal $k$ posed in this formulation. Status appears unknown / open.

status_evidence.title: Introduction to KAM theory with a view to celestial mechanics (Féjoz)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of KAM theory listing open problems on minimal regularity for openness of the union of KAM tori parameter sets.
status_evidence.claim: The question of the minimal $k$ for $C^k$-openness of $U$ is listed among open problems in KAM theory.

status_evidence.title: The Kolmogorov–Arnold–Moser theorem (Salamon)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses regularity hypotheses required to obtain invariant tori but does not pin down a sharp threshold for openness of the full union over Diophantine frequencies.
status_evidence.claim: Standard references state finite-differentiability KAM theorems but do not establish the exact minimal $k$.
